$comment: Stale plus a cap stop: the two things that make a workstream look idle when it is not. The text must say what the cap was and how many passes, not the word 'blocked' alone.
expectedText: enterprise-1854 · blocked · PR 1854 · checkpoint 2h ago · observed 1h ago · 1 desk item
enterprise-1854 · cap stop: passes 5/5 · PR 1854 · checkpoint 2h ago · observed 1h ago
assertions: freshness stale renders as an age, never as the word stale alone
capStop names the dimension and the counts, so a capped workstream cannot read as idle
observed.linear null with ageSeconds null renders as 'linear: never', not as 0m
